But however, who I am to opress you from mapping this but I wouldn't be surprised if someone would delete sooner or later. / Updated about 2 hours ago by balint36
Oh, I almost forget, it's really good that you mention that it's close for 16 moths and according the OSM wiki the closed road (or tramway, whatever) should be tag but I have two problems. First: The text that you quoted states that the road (or tramway, whatever) should be taged, not the portable pieces. Second: How comes the 16-month duration? The closure dure until 9 august. https://bkk.hu/menetrend-utazastervezes/forgalmi-hirek/nem-hajt-be-a-kozvagohid-h-vegallomasra-a-2-es-es-a-24-es-villamos-julius-8-tol-augusztus-9-ig.16949/ I really apprectiate when the people want to be helpful, but I don't like that someone from abroad wants to state us what he/she thinks that is the correct however he/she does not aware of the background facts. / Updated about 2 hours ago by balint36

[Alsó] Ismételten felhívjuk a lakosság figyelmét, hogy a kerítés előtti terület a PEMÜ Műanyagipari Zrt. magánterülete (lenti térképnek megfelelően), oda bejáró, avagy azon áthaladó személyes birtokháborítást követnek el.
